knowledge:
- key_parameters: subsets=Used in perFeatureQCMetrics to specify control sets of cells (e.g., empty wells) as a list of indices or names ;; features=Used in makePerCellDF to specify which feature's expression to extract into the data.frame ;; assay.type=Used in makePerCellDF and makePerFeatureDF to specify the input assay (e.g., "counts") ;; cells=Used in makePerFeatureDF to specify which cells' expression profiles to extract ;; clusters=Used in computePooledFactors to provide cell clustering information, which is critical for scaling normalization in heterogeneous populations
- alternatives: scrapper=Mentioned as a more efficient package containing implementations that supersede most of scuttle's deprecated or defunct functions ;; scran::quickCluster=Used to generate clusters for pooling normalization prior to running computePooledFactors
- when_to_use: Use when performing legacy single-cell RNA-seq preprocessing, specifically for calculating basic feature-level statistics, resolving non-unique gene symbols, converting SingleCellExperiment objects to standard data frames for plotting (e.g., with ggplot2), or applying pooling/spike-in scaling normalization.
- pitfalls: Filtering out very lowly or non-expressed genes before publishing is discouraged because it makes dataset integration and re-use difficult ;; Low-quality cells with few expressed genes can produce negative size factor estimates during pooling normalization; quality control should be performed prior to running computePooledFactors ;; medianSizeFactors can return NA/NaN values if sequencing coverage is insufficient to obtain well-defined ratios

workflows.name: feature_qc_and_data_transformation
workflows.intent: Calculate feature-level QC metrics, compute size-factor adjusted average expression, resolve duplicate gene symbols, and format data into data.frames for downstream analysis or plotting.
input: sce.ens (SingleCellExperiment object containing raw counts with Ensembl IDs as row names)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute feature-level QC metrics using perFeatureQCMetrics ;; 2. Calculate size-factor adjusted average expression using calculateAverage ;; 3. Resolve duplicate or missing gene symbols using uniquifyFeatureNames ;; 4. Convert cell or feature data to data.frames using makePerCellDF and makePerFeatureDF
workflows.code:
per.feat <- perFeatureQCMetrics(sce, subsets=list(Empty=1:10))
summary(per.feat$mean)
summary(per.feat$detected)
summary(per.feat$subsets_Empty_ratio)

ave <- calculateAverage(sce)
summary(ave)

rownames(sce.ens) <- uniquifyFeatureNames(
    rownames(sce.ens), rowData(sce.ens)$originalName
)

out <- makePerCellDF(sce, features="Tspan12", assay.type="counts")

out2 <- makePerFeatureDF(
    sce,
    cells=c("1772063062_D05", "1772063061_D01", "1772060240_F02", "1772062114_F05"),
    assay.type="counts"
)

workflows.name: scaling_normalization
workflows.intent: Perform scaling normalization on single-cell RNA-seq data using median-based, pooling-based (deconvolution), or spike-in-based methods to remove cell-specific technical biases.
workflows.stages: 1. Compute median-based size factors using medianSizeFactors ;; 2. Perform pooling normalization by first clustering cells (using scran::quickCluster or metadata) and then computing pooled size factors using computePooledFactors ;; 3. Alternatively, compute spike-in-based size factors using computeSpikeFactors if spike-in controls are available
workflows.code:
summary(medianSizeFactors(sce))

library(scran)
clusters <- quickCluster(sce)
sce <- computePooledFactors(sce, clusters=clusters)
summary(sizeFactors(sce))

sce <- computePooledFactors(sce, clusters=sce$level1class)
summary(sizeFactors(sce))

sce2 <- computeSpikeFactors(sce, "ERCC")
summary(sizeFactors(sce2))
